# VirtualTimeline { #timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline }

```python
timelines.VirtualTimeline(
    map,
    timeline,
    length,
    *,
    id=None,
    seed=None,
    _unknown_keys=dict[str, Any](),
    through=None,
    name=None,
)
```

The statement that a map was applied to a timeline, giving a timeline.

A virtual timeline exists only by applying the map: it has an ID, a
unit, a number type and a length of its own, and nothing else of it is
written. It holds no events, no children and no flow control. Its
positions and those of the timeline it comes from convert through the
map, in both directions (:meth:`unfold`, :meth:`fold`). It may be a
member of a group (:meth:`as_member`).

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name     | Type                                        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|----------|---------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| map      | [str](`str`)                                | The ID of the map applied: a FlowMap, or a conversion map.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| timeline | [str](`str`)                                | The ID of the timeline the map is applied to, or of another virtual timeline.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| length   | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) | The end of the virtual timeline on its own axis, which states its unit and number type too.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| through  | [str](`str`) \| None                        | The ID of the group that carries the map to ``timeline``: the FlowMap is one of a member of the group, ``timeline`` another member or a timeline inside one, and a position goes from one to the other by the group's conversion between its members. The ID of a conversion map is kept as read and not evaluated. |
| name     | [str](`str`) \| None                        | Optional display name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| id       | [str](`str`)                                | The virtual timeline's ID; minted with the prefix of its unit (``clt`` on quarters), as a timeline's is.                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.timelines import ContinuousLogicalTimeline
>>> score = ContinuousLogicalTimeline(length=24, uid="score")
>>> a = score.create_region(0, 16, id="a")
>>> b = score.create_region(16, 24, id="b")
>>> twice = score.create_flow_map([a, a, b], id="twice")
>>> played = score.create_virtual_timeline(twice, seed=7)
>>> played.id, played.length
('clt_1hvif5xc2r1fv', Coordinate(Fraction(40, 1), quarters))
>>> played.unfold(4, score)
[Coordinate(Fraction(4, 1), quarters), Coordinate(Fraction(20, 1), quarters)]
>>> played.fold(20, score)
Coordinate(Fraction(4, 1), quarters)
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [as_member](#timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.as_member) | Return this virtual timeline as a member of a group. |
| [fold](#timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.fold) | Return the position on ``timeline`` played at a position of this virtual timeline. |
| [from_dict](#timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.from_dict) | Restore a virtual timeline from its object in ``virtual_timelines``. |
| [from_flow_map](#timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.from_flow_map) | State that *flow_map* was applied to its root timeline. |
| [resolve](#timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.resolve) | Return the played order this virtual timeline is the axis of. |
| [unfold](#timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.unfold) | Return every position of this virtual timeline a position is played at. |

### as_member { #timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.as_member }

```python
timelines.VirtualTimeline.as_member(timeline)
```

Return this virtual timeline as a member of a group.

The member answers for the virtual timeline's axis, from 0 to its
length in its unit and number type, and for nothing else: a group
holding it reaches it with its timestamps, tabulates it and keeps it
in its display order, a bundle holding the group admits MatchClaims
naming it. Its ID stays the virtual timeline's, held in the manifest
of the tree it comes from; written, the group names it among its
``members``, and the virtual timeline stays one entry of
``virtual_timelines``. One virtual timeline gives one member object.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                              | Description                                                          | Default    |
|----------|---------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| timeline | [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.base.Timeline`) | The root holding this virtual timeline, or any timeline of its tree. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                | Description                    |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------|
|        | [VirtualMember](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.virtual.VirtualMember`) | The member, to add to a group. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                    |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the tree of *timeline* does not hold this virtual timeline. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.timelines import (
...     ContinuousLogicalTimeline,
...     ContinuousPhysicalTimeline,
...     TimelineGroup,
... )
>>> score = ContinuousLogicalTimeline(length=24, uid="score")
>>> a = score.create_region(0, 16, id="a")
>>> b = score.create_region(16, 24, id="b")
>>> played = score.create_virtual_timeline(
...     score.create_flow_map([a, a, b]), id="played"
... )
>>> recording = ContinuousPhysicalTimeline(length=80.0, uid="recording")
>>> group = TimelineGroup(timelines=[played.as_member(score), recording])
>>> stamp = group.get_timestamp_at(72.0, "recording")
>>> stamp.get_coordinate_for("played", format="coordinate")
Coordinate(Fraction(36, 1), quarters)
>>> played.fold(36, score)
Coordinate(Fraction(20, 1), quarters)
```

### fold { #timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.fold }

```python
timelines.VirtualTimeline.fold(coordinate, root)
```

Return the position on ``timeline`` played at a position of this virtual timeline.

``timeline`` is *root* without ``through``. With ``through`` a group,
the position the FlowMap gives on its own root is carried to
``timeline`` by the group's conversion between its members, in
``timeline``'s number type. See :meth:`ResolvedFlowMap.fold`.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                                    | Description                                                                                                              | Default    |
|------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| coordinate | [CoordinateInput](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.flowmap.CoordinateInput`) | A position on this virtual timeline's axis: a bare value, a Coordinate, or an IdCoordinate naming this virtual timeline. | _required_ |
| root       | [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.base.Timeline`)                       | The root timeline holding the virtual timeline.                                                                          | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                                         |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
|        | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) \| None | The position on ``timeline``, or None inside a gap. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                        |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | As :meth:`resolve` and :meth:`ResolvedFlowMap.fold`, or if an IdCoordinate names another timeline. |

### from_dict { #timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.from_dict }

```python
timelines.VirtualTimeline.from_dict(data)
```

Restore a virtual timeline from its object in ``virtual_timelines``.

IDs are bare. ``length`` is a bare value read as ``number_type``
decides; ``through`` and ``name`` may be left out. Keys the library
does not know are kept and written back.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                  | Default    |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|------------------------------|------------|
| data   | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | The virtual timeline object. | _required_ |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                     |
|--------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the object is malformed or its length is represented otherwise than its number type selects. |

### from_flow_map { #timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.from_flow_map }

```python
timelines.VirtualTimeline.from_flow_map(flow_map, root, *, id=None, name=None)
```

State that *flow_map* was applied to its root timeline.

The length is the FlowMap's virtual length, the unit and number type
are the root's.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                    | Description                                  | Default    |
|----------|---------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|------------|
| flow_map | [FlowMap](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.flowmap.FlowMap`) | The FlowMap applied.                         | _required_ |
| root     | [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.base.Timeline`)       | The root timeline it names.                  | _required_ |
| id       | [str](`str`) \| None                                    | The virtual timeline's ID; minted when None. | `None`     |
| name     | [str](`str`) \| None                                    | Optional display name.                       | `None`     |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                             |
|--------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the FlowMap cannot be read against *root* (:meth:`FlowMap.resolve`). |

### resolve { #timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.resolve }

```python
timelines.VirtualTimeline.resolve(root)
```

Return the played order this virtual timeline is the axis of.

The FlowMap's stretches on its own root: *root* when the virtual
timeline applies a FlowMap of *root* to *root*; with ``through`` a
group, the root among the group's members whose FlowMap it applies.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                              | Description                                     | Default    |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------|------------|
| root   | [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.base.Timeline`) | The root timeline holding the virtual timeline. | _required_ |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|--------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the virtual timeline applies another map (a conversion map), applies a FlowMap of *root* to another timeline than *root* without ``through``, or goes ``through`` a group that holds no timeline of *root*'s tree, holds no FlowMap of that ID among its members' trees, or has neither the FlowMap's root nor ``timeline`` among its members or inside one. Such a statement is kept and written back, but its positions are not converted. |

### unfold { #timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline.unfold }

```python
timelines.VirtualTimeline.unfold(coordinate, root)
```

Return every position of this virtual timeline a position is played at.

The position lies on ``timeline``, which is *root* without
``through``. With ``through`` a group, the position is first carried
to the FlowMap's root by the group's conversion between its members
(the group's own conversion between its members), in the
root's number type. See :meth:`ResolvedFlowMap.unfold`.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                                    | Description                                                                                       | Default    |
|------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| coordinate | [CoordinateInput](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.flowmap.CoordinateInput`) | A position on ``timeline``: a bare value, a Coordinate in its unit, or an IdCoordinate naming it. | _required_ |
| root       | [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.base.Timeline`)                       | The root timeline holding the virtual timeline.                                                   | _required_ |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                       |
|--------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | As :meth:`resolve` and :meth:`ResolvedFlowMap.unfold`, or if the position lies outside ``timeline`` in its group. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

A reading of one score applied to another score of the same
music, of another length, through their group:

```python
>>> from fractions import Fraction
>>> from timetoalign.core import Coordinate, TimeUnit
>>> from timetoalign.timelines import ContinuousLogicalTimeline, TimelineGroup
>>> score = ContinuousLogicalTimeline(length=24, uid="score")
>>> a = score.create_region(0, 16, id="a")
>>> b = score.create_region(16, 24, id="b")
>>> reading = score.create_flow_map([a, a, b], id="reading")
>>> edition = ContinuousLogicalTimeline(length=30, uid="edition")
>>> scores = TimelineGroup(id="scores", timelines=[score, edition])
>>> on_edition = edition.add_virtual_timeline(
...     VirtualTimeline(
...         "reading",
...         "edition",
...         Coordinate(40, TimeUnit.quarters),
...         through="scores",
...         id="edition_played",
...     )
... )
>>> on_edition.unfold(5, edition)
[Coordinate(Fraction(4, 1), quarters), Coordinate(Fraction(20, 1), quarters)]
>>> on_edition.fold(Fraction(37), edition)
Coordinate(Fraction(105, 4), quarters)
```
